quest.title: Good Hunter Express
quest.description: The Good Hunter has a special order that needs sending out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have other things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Okay. I'll look for someone else to help out...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: That would be great, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Please be careful while you make the delivery. <color=#00E1FFFF>Don't let any strange elements touch the food</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Also, <color=#00E1FFFF>do your best to avoid monsters, or they might knock the dish over</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Please hurry, this dish won't taste good if it gets cold.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Short-Tempered Wallit

dialogues.speaker: Short-Tempered Wallit
dialogues.text: Why hasn't my order arrived yet... What's with all this dilly-dallying, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Short-Tempered Wallit
dialogues.text: Oh, finally! Thank you, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Short-Tempered Wallit
dialogues.text: I've got to finish this quickly. I still have a ton of things to do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Yup, you've come at just the right moment — I'd just finished preparing this Sweet Madame.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Wallit ordered it earlier, and requested that we deliver it to a location west of the Dawn Winery later in the day...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: If you don't mind helping us out, could you take his order to him real quick?

dialogues.speaker: Short-Tempered Wallit
dialogues.text: Why hasn't my order arrived yet... What's with all this dilly-dallying, anyway?
